These inert HTML fixtures check source-listing detections separately from
browser execution. `cases.json` records expected findings. Controls cover
fixed-text replacement across three personal folders, append mode, preserved
file data, a single repeated folder, invalid versus valid ARC boot paths,
and active versus entity-escaped alert arguments.

The Yahoo Widget Engine 3.0 reference, pages 185 and 191, documents recursive
relative-name enumeration and whole-file text writes:
https://ecs.syr.edu/faculty/fawcett/handouts/CSE775/Presentations/WidgetEngineReference_3.0.pdf

No fixture executes the displayed widget source.
